gap:thresh.note: Lab example list outdated (autonomous replication is an OpenAI research category only); revenue floors are only in the US state laws. 'No binding instrument sets the second kind' holds: SB 53/RAISE oblige developers to define thresholds but set none (sb53#a2).

gap:eval.note: AI Act Art. 55 requires evaluation with adversarial testing, external only as appropriate (recital 114); the GPAI Code requires independent external evaluation. Korea Art. 32/34 risk management checked (S-0293#6, #8). SB 53 and RAISE contain no audit/third-party evaluation duty (S-0150#17, S-0033#18).

gap:elicit.note: GPAI Code requires state-of-the-art elicitation explicitly (Appendix 3.2) and is not a statute; matches pending P-0031.

gap:timing.note: Illinois adds 72-hour incident reporting from 2027; EU instance is Art. 55(1)(c) GPAI incident reporting, not AI Office post-market monitoring (P-0095).

gap:sec.note: 'No US state covers weight security' is contradicted by SB 53 §22757.12(a)(7), RAISE §1421(1)(g), Illinois §10(a)(7). EU AI Act Art. 55(1)(d) (S-0002#16), GPAI Code Commitment 6 (S-0044#9) and Hiroshima action 6 (hcoc#a6) confirm the other claims.

gap:halt.note: Each member checked: EU recall power from Aug 2026; GPAI Code Measure 4.2; Seoul commitment IV; labs — OpenAI halts development at Critical (S-0095#6), GDM gates deployment via governance with no 'halt/pause' wording (S-0102#20), Meta replaced 'stop' (S-0107#5), xAI proceed-only-if-acceptable and temporary shutdown (S-0108#8, #9), Anthropic competitor-dependent delays (S-0006#12). China's Art. 21 suspension power contradicts 'no other national statute'.

gap:acct.note: Binding incident reporting: SB 53 (S-0150#10), RAISE (S-0033#5), EU AI Act (S-0002#15). OECD transparency principle (S-0136#9), UNESCO transparency and explainability (unesco#p37). Action Plan funding lever (S-0274#3) and EO 14365 Task Force (S-0239#5) support 'limiting state oversight'. 44 of 50 entries carry acct notes (internal). FMF characterisation consistent with P-0035.

gap:update.note: AI Act also updates by delegated act (P-0096). SB 53 annual review and 30-day publication (S-0150#7) supports 'keep frameworks current'. Built-in review: NIST formal review by 2028 (nist#review), OECD reporting on continued relevance (S-0136#11), CoE Conference of the Parties follow-up (S-0139#6).
